SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9411/6
Date ____ / 6 40

May 29, 1940. Afternoon Translation.

NATNIGHT

OPPRESSION OF GERMANS IN FRENCH CONCESSION INTENSIFIED:
400 GERMANS IN PANIC

The oppression of Germans in the
French Concession has been intensified. Six Germans were
expelled in April. The cause of one case is reported to be
that the man had clapped his hands at the sight of Hitler
during a film exhibition at the Cathay Theatre in the French
Concession.

About 400 German residents in
the French Concession are living in great uneasiness under
the observation of the French authorities.

S. B. 登记处

1940年5月29日。下午译本。

NATNIGHT（原文如此，疑为 NIGHT 之误）

法租界对德籍人士的压迫加剧：
400名德侨陷入恐慌

法租界对德籍人士的压迫已加剧。四月份有六名德籍人士被驱逐出境。据报，其中一案的起因是该男子在法租界国泰大戏院（Cathay Theatre）观看电影时，因见到希特勒而鼓掌。

约有400名居住在法租界的德籍居民，在法国当局的监视下生活得极为不安。

TAIRIKU SHIMPO 7.9.39

BRITISH OUTRAGES TO BE IMPEACHED

The Tairiku Shimpo publishes the
following comment:-

Involved in the European war,
Great Britain is following the example of Japan in the
China incident. Japan has declared that she is fighting
the Chiang Kai Shek regime and not the Chinese people.
Great Britain is propagating that she is fighting Hitler
and not the German people. On September 4 Mr. Chamberlain
broadcasted a speech in the German language to that effect.

What is happening in Shanghai?
On September 3 British soldiers destroyed a German tennis
club and tore up a Nazi flag. In connection with this
incident, even British newspapers have found it difficult
to speak in favour of the offenders and have advised British
residents to exercise greater care. However, similar
incidents are taking place almost every day.

British people are so excited
that they are criticizing trifle incidents created accidental-
ly by Japanese soldiers. However, as soon as she has
become involved in a war she becomes barbarous, forgetting
immediately anything about gentlemanly behaviour and
common sense.

Although strongly advocating
the neutrality of the International Settlement, the British
people regard it as their concession. It cannot be over-
looked that the British people are acting as they wish in
the International Settlement, while Germans are maintaining
a calm attitude for they understand the complicated situation
in Shanghai. This does not disagree with our policy of
non-intervention with the European war. We must impeach
the attempt of Britain to bring the European war into
Shanghai.

We deny the neutrality of the
Settlement. We maintain that the Settlements are under the
control of Japan in the same way as other occupied areas.

《大陆新报》 1939年9月7日

将谴责英国的暴行

《大陆新报》发表如下评论：-

卷入欧洲战争的英国，正效仿日本在“中国事变”中的做法。日本宣称其作战对象是蒋介石政权，而非中国人民。英国则宣传其作战对象是希特勒，而非德国人民。9月4日，张伯伦先生以此意旨发表了德语广播演说。

上海发生了什么事？9月3日，英国士兵捣毁了一家德国网球俱乐部，并撕毁了一面纳粹旗帜。就此事件而言，连英国报纸也难以替肇事者辩护，并建议英籍居民更加谨慎行事。然而，类似的事件几乎每天都在发生。

英国人情绪如此激动，以至于对日本士兵偶然制造的琐碎事件也大加指责。然而，一旦卷入战争，他们便变得野蛮，立刻抛却了绅士风度和常识。

尽管英国人强烈主张国际租界的中立，但他们却将其视为自己的租界。不容忽视的是，英国人在国际租界内随心所欲地行动，而德籍人士则因了解上海的复杂局势而保持冷静态度。这与我们不干预欧洲战争的政策并不相悖。我们必须谴责英国试图将欧洲战争引入上海的企图。

SAITOH SHIRO 6.9.39

OUR DECLARATION OF NEUTRALITY AND THE ANTI-BRITISH MOVEMENT

The declaration issued by our government clearly indicates that Japan will not be drawn into the European conflict and that she will endeavour to settle the China incident. This is our government's policy. The Powers, whether involved in the war or not, are undoubtedly interested in the diplomatic policy of Japan because she will make use of the European situation in dealing with the China incident.
The diplomatic policy of the Hiranuma Cabinet was based on morality. Before we could see the results of this policy it was replaced by the Abe Cabinet. Of course, the fundamental policy adopted by the Konoye Cabinet in dealing with the China affair will never be changed despite any changes in the Cabinet. However, the enforcement of the policy will be changed in accordance with the rapidly changing situation.
It is clear that third Powers have been obstructing a settlement of the China affair by rendering assistance to China. It is believed that the European war will affect such assistance. Judging by their movements, third Powers will continue to demonstrate a hostile attitude towards Japan and continue their assistance to China under the pretext of protecting their own interests. However, our policy to overthrow such attitude will not be changed.
Our government has declared that it will not side with Germany or with Britain and France. Some may think that Japan will become friends with Britain and will reconsider the anti-British movement in China. Such a school of thought shows lack of appreciation of our policy. The hostile attitude of Great Britain towards Japan is responsible for the anti-British movement; unless such hostility is removed it will be impossible for Japan to attain her object. Japan will never loose her firm hand in chastizing them, should Britain, France or Soviet refuse to change their attitude.

斋藤四郎 1939年9月6日

我们的中立宣言与反英运动

我国政府发表的宣言明确指出，日本不会被卷入欧洲冲突，并将致力于解决“中国事变”。这是我国政府的政策。无论是否参战，列强无疑都关注日本的外交政策，因为日本将在处理“中国事变”时利用欧洲局势。
平沼内阁的外交政策基于道德原则。在该政策见效之前，它便被阿部内阁所取代。当然，近卫内阁在处理“中国事变”时所采取的基本政策绝不会因内阁的任何更迭而改变。然而，政策的执行将根据迅速变化的局势进行调整。
显然，第三国通过援助中国，阻碍了“中国事变”的解决。据信，欧洲战争将影响此类援助。从第三国的动向判断，它们将继续以保护自身利益为借口，对日本表现出敌对态度并继续援助中国。然而，我们要推翻这种态度的政策不会改变。
我国政府已宣布不偏袒德国或英法。有些人可能认为日本将与英国修好，并重新考虑在华的反英运动。这种思潮表明其对我国政策缺乏理解。反英运动是由英国对日本的敌对态度引起的；除非消除这种敌意，否则日本不可能实现其目标。如果英国、法国或苏联拒绝改变其态度，日本绝不会放松对他们的严厉惩戒。

6. 9. 39

FILE

CONFIDENCE IN S.M.C. FALLS: THIRD PARTY NATIONALS
FROWN UPON OUTRAGEOUS ACTS OF BRITISH

A number of British and French
residents in the Foreign Settlements are reported to'
have act:d outrageously towards Germans who are maintaining
a calm attitude. Third Power nationals are frowning
over' such behaviour.
Members of the British Defence
Force and the S.M.P. are said to be responsible for the
outrages. British residents are reported to have
acted outrageously towards innocent Chinese. Should
this state of affairs be allow:d to continue, the
maintenance of peace and order in the Settlement will.
be difficult. For this reason, Chinese people here
are said to be hoping that Japan will take suitable
measures in this connection.

《每日新闻》（Jaioku Shimpo，音译，疑为 Mainichi Shimbun 之误植或特定版别）
1939年9月6日

档案

对工部局的信心下降：第三国国民对英国的暴行表示不满

据报，公共租界内的一些英法籍居民对保持冷静态度的德籍人士采取了暴行。第三国国民对此类行为表示不满。
据称，英国防卫队成员和工部局警务处（S.M.P.）人员应对这些暴行负责。据报道，英籍居民还对无辜的中国百姓采取了暴行。如果允许这种状态持续下去，租界内的和平与秩序将难以维持。因此，据称在沪华人希望日本能在此方面采取适当措施。

pages.en:
Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper): 7.9.39 (AM)

“RUN ON BRITISH BANKS IN SHANGHAI”

Fearing the overthrow of British influence
after the outbreak of a second European war, Chinese people
as well as nationals of a third Power in Shanghai are
withdrawing their deposits from British banks and transferring
them to banks of a third nation.
British bankers and industrialists recently
undertook counter-propaganda against the neutral policy of
Japan and spread the following rumours:-
1) That the conclusion of an alliance between Japan and
Britain has become a possibility.
2) That Britain will issue a loan of £50,000,000 to Japan
in the near future.
Upon learning of these rumours, the Japanese
authorities became highly indignant. Apart from refuting
these rumours, Japan has announced that she will maintain
her neutrality and will not help any of the belligerents.

FILE
pages.zh:
《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：1939年9月7日（上午）

“上海英商银行出现挤兑”

出于对第二次欧洲战争爆发后英国影响力被推翻的恐惧，在沪华人以及第三国国民正从英商银行提取存款，并将其转存至第三国银行。
英国银行家和实业家最近开展反宣传，反对日本的中立政策，并散布以下谣言：-
1) 日本与英国结盟已成为可能。
2) 英国将在不久的将来向日本提供5,000万英镑的贷款。
得知这些谣言后，日本当局极为愤慨。除了驳斥这些谣言外，日本还宣布将保持中立，不帮助任何交战方。

September 7, 1939. Morning Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper):

**ALLEGED BRITISH OPPRESSION OF GERMANS**

British circles are intensifying their oppression of Germans in Shanghai, as witness the resolute action taken by British companies in dismissing the Germans in their employ. One of these British firms is the Ewo Brewery Ltd. which took the initiative in the matter, for it discharged some ten German employees, including technical experts, on September 5. Other British and French firms will follow this example and discharge their German employees.

Unable to bear the oppression in the French Concession, many Germans have taken refuge in Hongkew. The Broadway Mansions now has more than 50 German families. It is believed that if the Germans in Shanghai do not return to Germany, a large number of those who are residing in the Foreign Settlements will probably look for safer residence in Hongkew.

On the morning of September 5, the German-owned cargoes stored in British godowns and warehouses were removed by the owners concerned and transferred to custody of a third Power, such as America or China.
pages.zh:
1939年9月7日。上午译本。

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：

**涉嫌英国压迫德籍人士**

英国圈子正在加剧对在沪德籍人士的压迫，英国公司坚决解雇其雇佣的德籍员工便是明证。怡和啤酒有限公司（Ewo Brewery Ltd.）在此事中率先行动，于9月5日解雇了包括技术专家在内的约十名德籍员工。其他英法公司将效仿此举，解雇其德籍员工。

由于无法忍受法租界的压迫，许多德籍人士已避难至虹口。百老汇大厦（Broadway Mansions）现居住着50多个德国家庭。据信，如果在沪德籍人士不返回德国，那些居住在公共租界的大量德侨可能会寻求在虹口获得更安全的住所。

9月5日上午，存放在英国堆栈和仓库中的德商货物被相关货主提走，并转移至美国或中国等第三国保管。

September 5, 1939.

MAINICHI

FRENCH CONCESSION AUTHORITIES PROHIBIT HOISTING
OF GERMAN NATIONAL FLAG

Yesterday afternoon the French
Municipal authorities issued a notice prohibiting the
hoisting of the German national flag over any building or
motor car or in any other way in the French Concession.
More than 600 of the 700 German residents in Shanghai
reside in the French Concession and they were much startled
by the notification of the Concession authorities.

IMPORTANT MILITARY OFFICERS OF THE FRENCH DEFENCE
FORCE HOLD CONFERENCE

As a result of the declaration
of war on Germany by Great Britain, France declared war on
Germany at 1 a.m. (Japan time) September 4.
Upon receiving a report, the
French Ambassador to China held a conference with important
officers of the French Defence Force and the French Municipal
Council to discuss the maintenance of peace and order in
the Concession after the French Defence Force has been
sent to a certain place.

BRITISH EMPLOYEES OF S.M.C. REGISTER WITH THEIR
CONSULATE FOR VOLUNTARY SERVICE

90% of the British employees
of the S.M.C. are reported to be reservists and 50% of them
has received orders from their home government to confine
themselves at home.
As the British Government has
declared war on Germany the British employees of the S.M.C.,
who are reservists, are continually registering with their
Consulate for voluntary military service. Even British
employees of the S.M.C. holding the rank of Sectional Chief,
are said to have reported to their Consulate for military
service. This is attracting attention in various quarters.

pages.zh:
1939年9月5日。

《每日新闻》

法租界当局禁止悬挂德国国旗

昨日下午，法公董局发布通告，禁止在法租界内的任何建筑物或汽车上，或以任何其他方式悬挂德国国旗。在上海的700名德籍居民中，有600多人居住在法租界，他们对租界当局的这一通知感到十分震惊。

法国防卫部队重要军官举行会议

由于英国于9月4日凌晨1点（日本时间）对德宣战，法国也随之对德宣战。
法国驻华大使在收到报告后，与法国防卫部队的重要军官及法公董局举行了会议，讨论在法国防卫部队被派往某地后，如何维持租界内的和平与秩序。

工部局英籍雇员向领事馆登记志愿服役

据报道，工部局（S.M.C.）的英籍雇员中有90%是后备役人员，其中50%已收到本国政府命令，要求他们居家待命。
由于英国政府对德宣战，身为后备役人员的工部局英籍雇员不断向领事馆登记志愿参军。据悉，甚至连担任股长级别的工部局英籍雇员也已向领事馆报到服役。此事引起了各界的关注。

September 5, 1939.

MAINICHI

FRENCH CONCESSION AUTHORITIES PROHIBIT HOISTING
OF GERMAN NATIONAL FLAG

Yesterday afternoon the French
Municipal authorities issued a notice prohibiting the
hoisting of the German national flag over any building or
motor car or in any other way in the French Concession.
More than 600 of the 700 German residents in Shanghai
reside in the French Concession and they were much startled
by the notification of the Concession authorities.

1939年9月5日。

《每日新闻》

法租界当局禁止悬挂德国国旗

昨日下午，法公董局发布通告，禁止在法租界内的任何建筑物或汽车上，或以任何其他方式悬挂德国国旗。在上海的700名德籍居民中，有600多人居住在法租界，他们对租界当局的这一通知感到十分震惊。

Stimp
4.9.39

BRITISH EMPLOYEES OF THE S.M.P. AND THE WAR

As a result of the outbreak of hostilities in Europe the British members of the S.M.P. are expected to be called upon for military service because many of them are reservists. The British Government may not call upon them on the ground that they are defending the Shanghai Settlement, but the Government will accept their voluntary service. For this reason, many of them may vacate their posts. However, Major Bourne, Commissioner of the S.M.P., who is on the reserve list, and Captain Smyth, Deputy Commissioner, also a reservist, are expected not to be called upon for military service.

(Note:- Commissioner's copy)

工部局警务处的英籍雇员与战争

由于欧洲战事爆发，预计工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的英籍成员将被征召服兵役，因为他们中许多人都是后备役人员。英国政府可能以他们正在保卫上海租界为由不征召他们，但政府将接受他们的志愿服役。因此，他们中许多人可能会离职。然而，列入后备役名单的工部局警务处处长伯恩少校（Major Bourne），以及同样为后备役的副处长史密斯上尉（Captain Smyth），预计不会被征召服兵役。

（注：- 处长副本）
